authorization: Owner directed all remaining DAG proofs; exact original Jacobi/Volterra majorization obligation.
space: E=R^2 with standard Euclidean inner product; D(s),R(s) are real continuous linear maps E->E; norm is the induced Euclidean operator norm.
regularity: D has first derivative D1 and D1 has derivative D2 on [0,L] in the finite-dimensional operator Banach space.
D2 and R are continuous on [0,L].
jacobi_data: D2(t)=-R(t) composed with D(t) for t in [0,L]

definitions.f_K(s): s for K=0; sinh(sqrt(K)s)/sqrt(K) for K>0

accepted_dependencies.statement: Banach/componentwise integral Taylor formula from two derivatives; scalar proof accepted and finite-dimensional component application must be justified, not assumed as target.
Universal scalar Volterra comparison for continuous u under u<=s+K integral kernel u.

targets.CAS-07-M04-VOLTERRA-IDENTITY: D(s)=s*Id - integral_0^s (s-t)*(R(t) composed with D(t)) dt.

required_controls: All Bochner integrals are in finite-dimensional continuous-linear-map space
No determinant/sign/area-distance conclusion in this unit
excluded: Determinant positivity/sign continuity and singular values
Physical screen transport existence beyond supplied ODE regularity
